lastCompletedStory.title: Marker removal on any non-preflight-failed plan result (Option B)

nextStoryContext: US-004 added `removePreflightFailedMarkerFn?: () => void` to RunPostAuditOptions (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts) and wires it via a new one-line-call helper `removePreflightMarkerUnlessPreflightFailed(kind, fn)` (extracted purely to stay under biome's noExcessiveLinesPerFunction(80) ceiling -- the 2-line conditional plus its explanatory comment alone pushed runPostAuditAction to 83 lines; the helper carries the full rationale in its own JSDoc so the call site in runPostAuditAction is a single line, placed as the FIRST statement in the function body, before the existing kind-dispatch if-chain). The call fires unconditionally for every planResult.kind that is NOT 'preflight-failed' -- Option B, confirmed distinct from the pre-existing removeEscalationMarkerFn (which fires ONLY on the proceed-branch convergence path): tests explicitly assert removePreflightFailedMarkerFn IS called on pause-operator, audit-blocked, and plan-escalated (the exact three paths where removeEscalationMarkerFn is asserted NOT called), plus audit-approved/planner-failed/mutex-busy/plan-target-invalid, and NOT called on preflight-failed itself. Production wiring: sidecar.ts's runPostPlanActions now passes `removePreflightFailedMarkerFn: () => removePlanPreflightFailedMarker(join(o.claudeDir, PLAN_PREFLIGHT_FAILED_FILENAME))` (imported removePlanPreflightFailedMarker from ../supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts, sibling of the pre-existing removeEscalationMarkerFn line calling removePlanEscalatedMarker); removePlanPreflightFailedMarker already existed from US-002 and is a best-effort unlinkSync wrapped in try/catch, so it never throws when the file is already absent (no new test needed for that half -- it's exercised by the existing US-002 marker module tests). File-size budget raised: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts 1228->1272, src/commands/sidecar.ts 2301->2307 (tracker ref CAM-215 in the _ref diff). US-005 is next (orchestrator boot step 9: read the preflight-failed marker) -- this is a DIFFERENT surface: the two agent-instruction markdown copies (.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md and templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, NOT byte-identical today per the cam-dual-copy-is-per-file gotcha) each gain a new boot step 9 + opening-blocker section mirroring the existing step 7 (ship-stalled) / step 8 (plan-escalated) prose, then src/vendor/_generated.ts is regenerated via bun run embed-vendor. This is doc-authoring work, NOT a plan-runner.ts/sidecar.ts code seam like this story and US-002/US-003 -- re-read the US-005 PRD note fresh rather than assuming file scope from this note.
